source_note: Chinese hot-topic candidates are collected from public trend pages; English wording is matched to supplied official English headlines when possible, otherwise suggested neutrally.

topics.chinese_topic: 六大行房贷余额少了5000多亿
topics.official_english: Balance of housing loans at China's six largest banks dropped by over 500 billion yuan
topics.why_hot: A big drop in mortgage balances at the six largest state-owned banks is rare and fuels discussion about household spending and the housing market.
topics.share_angle: Explain what the mortgage decline suggests about Chinese households' balance sheets and where the property market may be heading.

topics.chinese_topic: 女生自学手搓AI历史短剧播放破亿
topics.official_english: Self-taught woman's AI-made historical short drama surpasses 100 million views
topics.why_hot: A solo creator reportedly used AI tools to make a historical short drama that went viral, showing how dramatically content production is changing.
topics.share_angle: Break down how AI is lowering the barrier for short-drama creators and what this means for traditional film and TV work.

topics.chinese_topic: 华为小米荣耀手机今日集体调价
topics.official_english: Huawei, Xiaomi and Honor phones see collective price adjustments
topics.why_hot: Several major phone brands adjusting prices on the same day is unusual and directly affects millions of consumers.
topics.share_angle: Discuss the possible reasons behind simultaneous smartphone price changes, from component costs to competitive pressure.

topics.chinese_topic: 退休阿姨81天环游20国 仅花3.7万元
topics.official_english: Retired woman visits 20 countries in 81 days for just 37,000 yuan
topics.why_hot: A retiree's low-cost, fast-paced trip around the world is inspiring and raises practical questions about budget travel in later life.
topics.share_angle: Use the story to explore how retirees can plan affordable international travel and manage costs without giving up comfort.

topics.chinese_topic: 年轻人结婚开始用金条代替三金
topics.official_english: Young couples start using gold bars instead of traditional 'three golds' for weddings
topics.why_hot: A change in wedding gift customs reflects younger people's preference for practical, investment-style gifts over traditional gold jewelry.
topics.share_angle: Explain what replacing 'three golds' with gold bars says about changing wedding traditions and young people's money values.

topics.chinese_topic: 深圳校服 全市统一商超可买
topics.official_english: Shenzhen school uniforms to be sold in supermarkets citywide
topics.why_hot: Making school uniforms widely available in ordinary supermarkets is a practical citywide move that affects thousands of families.
topics.share_angle: Discuss how standardized uniforms sold through normal retail channels could improve convenience and lower costs for parents.

topics.chinese_topic: 一学期只有一次课堂紧急如厕机会
topics.official_english: School rule allows only one emergency bathroom break per semester
topics.why_hot: A strict bathroom policy has angered students and parents because it touches on children's basic health needs in school.
topics.share_angle: Examine the balance between classroom discipline and children's health, and how such rules are justified by schools.

topics.chinese_topic: 女子被踢845个群被迫离职 当地通报
topics.official_english: Woman says she was forced out of job after being removed from 845 group chats; local authorities respond
topics.why_hot: A bizarre workplace dispute involving hundreds of group chat removals has gone viral and drawn an official response.
topics.share_angle: Use the case to talk about group-chat overload in Chinese workplaces and where the line between management and harassment lies.
